name: Laplacian Pyramid Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering technique for multiresolution decomposed 3D volume data using Laplacian pyramid compression, where voxel values are reconstructed on-the-fly from compressed data and maintained in a cache to reduce redundant reconstruction.
summary: Laplacian Pyramid Volume Rendering is a direct volume rendering technique that reconstructs voxel values on-the-fly from compressed Gaussian pyramid data, using caching to minimize redundant computation.
